messages:
adele: heads-up: promotion job stalled for personalization-service, deploy-bot shows digest mismatch between registry and promotion cache. Canary never started.
deploy-bot: promotion-failure: digest-lock-detected. Cached tag sha256 mismatch: registry reports sha256:aa11bb22, promotion cache has sha256:ff00ee11. Automatic promotion paused.
kevin: which pipeline produced the cache? last successful promotion was pipeline 1729 at 03:12 UTC. We bumped tag yesterday from ephemeral-ci to release-candidate.
prio-product: customers expecting feature gated rollout today. Can we manually reconcile?
sre-lead: reconcile steps: 1) verify artifacts in registry and mirror, 2) pin to chosen digest and annotate HelmRelease to avoid re-promote, 3) update release notes to mention pinned digest.
adele: I'll check registry now: `crane digest ghcr.company/personalization:v2026-03-21`.
kevin: I see two digests in mirrors. EU mirror shows ff00ee11 (older), canonical registry shows aa11bb22 (newer). Looks like mirror promotion lagged and deploy-bot picked mirror digest earlier.
sre-lead: we should prefer canonical registry unless mirror promotion is explicit. Manual flow: pin to canonical digest, annotate, then resume promotion.
kevin: commands I'll run (dry-run first):
```
# pin helmrelease to canonical digest and prevent auto re-promote
kubectl -n prod annotate helmrelease personalization \
  release.redwood.io/image-digest=sha256:aa11bb22 \
  release.redwood.io/auto-promote=false --overwrite
helm upgrade --install personalization ./charts/personalization \
  --set image.digest=sha256:aa11bb22 --namespace prod --dry-run
```
prio-product: make sure to include a short release-note line: "Pinned image digest to canonical registry due to mirror promotion lag; no functional change."
adele: running check now. Dry-run good. Proceeding to apply.
deploy-bot: detected manual override annotation and blocked auto-promote cleared. Manual promotion allowed. Creating incident record: promotion-digest-lock-1767891234.
kevin: applied annotate and performed helm upgrade with digest pinned. Rolling out new revision with canary fraction 10%.
sre-lead: please monitor pod image source and registries. `kubectl get pods -o wide` should show image ID matching sha256:aa11bb22.
adele: pods appear with image ID sha256:aa11bb22 and pull source canonical-registry. Canary pods healthy at 5m sample.
prio-product: thanks team. I'll update customer comms to call out pinned digest and that full rollout will proceed after verification.
release-manager: creating follow-up RDW-599 to fix promotion cache race and add a preflight that verifies digest parity across mirrors before automatic promotion. Targeting fix in next sprint.
sre-lead: also adding a cleanup task to reconcile mirror promotions and ensure mirror backfill for any missing digests.
kevin: note for runbook: to unpin and re-enable auto-promote after mirror parity is fixed run: `kubectl annotate helmrelease personalization release.redwood.io/auto-promote=true --overwrite` and `kubectl annotate helmrelease personalization release.redwood.io/image-digest-locked-removed=true --overwrite` then redeploy.
adele: all set. Canary running, moving to monitor window 30m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident logged. If rollback needed: `helm rollback personalization <prev-revision>` or `kubectl annotate helmrelease personalization release.redwood.io/auto-promote=false` to freeze promotion.
